description:
Update parent inspection and control surfaces so orchestrated work is usable: `list_minions`, `show_minion`, and `halt`.

## Background

Without this, the parent can spawn/orchestrate but cannot see role, taskType, description, group, domain, comm indicators, or halt a group. That is worse UX than tmux pane names. Beadwork has no fleet UI on purpose; minions *is* the fleet UI/tools.

## Files

- `packages/pi-minions/src/tools/minions.ts` (list/show)
- `packages/pi-minions/src/tools/halt.ts` (one child or group; abort emits `aborted` not `failed`)
- `packages/pi-minions/src/commands/` if user commands exist
- `packages/pi-minions/src/status.ts` / renderers: optional statusline of orchestrated counts (not beadwork)
- tests

Do not edit `orchestrate.ts` here (sibling). Do not import beadwork.

## Behavior

- list/show distinguish spawn vs orchestrated.
- Show full output, messages, path intent, activity. Large text lives here, not in packets.
- halt id=all still works; halt group forgets the open group after drain so the next orchestrate creates a new id. Halt does **not** exit Beadwork goal mode (that's beadwork).
- Children do not receive halt.

## Success criteria

- Parent can answer: who is running, what taskType, what they last said, whether a peer message failed.
- Halt of a running orchestrated child yields an `aborted` packet (once packets exist).

## Test plan

- Unit: list filters, show fields, halt one vs group vs missing id.
- Integration: halt → aborted status on the tree; spawn child halt still works as today.
- Logging: each list/show/halt test logs id, kind, groupId, status.

## Considerations

Blocked until tree metadata and orchestrate/group exist. Packet emission of aborted is owned by the packets issue; this issue must call the same abort path as the runner.
title: Update list_minions, show_minion, and halt for orchestrated groups
